children.value: > Fact From Story: He has the unwanted title of being the first New Zealand coach to lose a World Cup pool match but now a semi-final awaits next Friday evening against an Argentina side that, frankly, are a tier below them.
> > Fact From Story: Foster will leave his role after the World Cup, to be replaced by all-conquering Crusaders boss Scott Robertson, but he can still exit with the greatest prize of all.
> > > Fact From Story: Forget the hand-wringing ahead of the tournament, the All Blacks are one very small step away from another World Cup final.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A semi-final win puts a team one step away from the final.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Coaches want to exit their job with a victory.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Winning a semi-final puts a team in the final.
